memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: (When the territory of the Danites was lost to them, they went up and attacked Leshem, took it, put it to the sword and occupied it. They settled in Leshem and named it Dan after their ancestor.) This was the inheritance of the tribe of Dan according to its clans, these towns and their villages - Josh 19:47-48 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
This brief note tells of Dan's migration north. Struggling to hold their assigned territory, they went far away, captured the city of Leshem, and renamed it Dan after their ancestor. On the surface it looks like initiative and success — they found land, took it, and settled. But behind it lies the sadness of a tribe that left the place God had given them because the assigned inheritance proved too difficult to hold.

Scripture records this without loud judgment, simply telling what happened. Yet the wider story is not encouraging. Dan's northern settlement would later become a centre of idolatry in Israel, and in the book of Revelation the tribe of Dan is notably absent from the list of the sealed (Rev 7). The choice to seek an easier place, away from God's assignment, cast a long shadow over this tribe's future.

We can learn from this with humility rather than harsh judgment. It is not always wrong to move or change circumstances — but our hearts must stay tender to whether we are following God or simply fleeing difficulty. The safest place is always the centre of God's will, even when it is hard, rather than an easier place chosen in discouragement. Wherever we are, the call is to keep our hearts fixed on the Lord and to seek His guidance, trusting that His assignments, however challenging, are for our good (Prov 3:5-6).

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- How do you discern between God-led change and fleeing difficulty?
- Why is the centre of God's will safer than an easier path chosen in discouragement?
- How can you keep your heart tender to God's guidance in your decisions?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, help me to discern between following Your leading and simply fleeing difficulty. Keep my heart fixed on You, and lead me to trust that Your assignments are for my good. Amen.
